_about: Every query-string key the UI builds or reads (IR-918), and why it carries nothing personal. scripts/url-privacy.test.mjs fails on a key not listed here; src/lib/urlPrivacy.test.ts holds the builders to this list. Adding a key is a review decision: name it in the same change, with the reason it is safe -- an id, a number or a fixed vocabulary.

keys.event_type: a named audit event type from the server's fixed list, sent only by System Admin pages (IR-795)
keys.days: a retention period in whole days, or blank, sent only by the System Admin's Retention page (IR-795)
keys.id: record ids for a list lookup
keys.status: a named status (legacy, read once and replaced)
keys.myfeed: the numeric id of one of the reader's own saved feeds (IR-577); an id is not an identity and the feed's name and query are never in the address
keys.code: a session-end code from a fixed list
keys.q: the Discover search text the reader typed (a shareable search, never an identity)
keys.next: an in-app path, validated by safeRedirectPath, so the reader returns after signing in
